slides.title:
Sustainability isn't
the garnish here.
slides.body:
Plenty of bars treat zero waste as a line on the menu. Zest builds the drink around it. Jeju hallabong is juiced for its Garibaldi, the peels then infuse the house gin, and the leftover pulp becomes a cordial or gets fermented.

The bar also carbonates its own water on site to cut plastic, and uses reusable towels in place of paper napkins.

caption:
A Cheongdam bar named for the thing most bars bin — citrus peel — and for "zero waste".

Zest took No. 2 on Asia's 50 Best Bars 2026 and Best Bar in Korea for a fourth year. Hallabong is juiced, the peels infuse the house gin, the pulp becomes cordial.

Hours and menus change, so it's worth checking before you go.
